en: Colorized historical postcard depicting the Industriehalle (industrial hall) during the autumn fair in Graz. The foreground shows well‑dressed men, women and children in early 20th‑century clothing walking and socializing in front of a decorated entrance arch with greenery and flags. The archway bears the words for the Graz autumn fair, and the facade of the ornate exhibition building behind it is labeled "INDUSTRIE-HALLE." Ticket booths labeled "KASSE" flank the entrance. At the top in red print there is a German caption describing the scene.
